caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length child's dress that appears to be made of light fabric, likely white or off-white in color. The dress features long sleeves with lace detailing at the cuffs, a lacy yoke and collar, and three buttons running down the front of the bodice, with an additional button at the waistband. The skirt is decorated with elaborate embroidery and lacework, displaying patterns of leaves, flowers, and scalloped edges, with small openwork holes throughout the lace areas. The background is a plain, light beige tone, and the entire composition is centered on the dress, with no other visible objects present. The artist's name, "James Fitilian," is written in small letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Doll Dress
